contributions.detail: TWO printed anchors and BOTH close, on different scopes of the same row set. (1) All 5 inked Form A rows sum to 5,021.91, exactly the schedule's own printed TOTAL. (2) The filer itemized his one SUB-$50 gift (Ron Densley, 25.00) on Form A even though the form only requires over-$50 gifts; drop that row and the remaining four sum to 4,996.91, exactly the cover's line 1 (over-$50) THIS and CUMULATIVE cells, while the dropped row alone equals the cover's line 2 ($50-or-less aggregate) 25.00. Scored on schedule-total because the emitted row set is all 5 rows. This is the filer's FIRST report of the 2020 cycle (line 1/2/3 LAST-REPORT cells all hold a slashed zero), so the THIS and CUMULATIVE cells are equal and the two scopes coincide - recorded 'cumulative' per the addendum. The double closure also independently fixes row 4's clipped final digit (see that row's note).

expenditures.detail: All 23 inked Form B rows sum to exactly 5,021.91 = the schedule's handwritten TOTAL = the cover's line 3 THIS and CUMULATIVE cells (three anchors, all agreeing). First report of the cycle, so the THIS and CUMULATIVE scopes coincide. The printed TOTAL cell originally held a different figure that the filer scribbled out beyond legibility; he rewrote 5,021.91 immediately below the total rule - that rewritten figure is the anchor recorded here, and the struck figure is left as null-illegible rather than guessed.

gates.row_count: rowbands.py column-restricted to the Amount band (--col) returned a clean 1.72-pct rule ladder on both sheets (36 rules each; the heavy every-5th group rules are merged, so the ladder is read as bands, not counted blindly). p2: 5 inked bands from the top rule down, then empty to the footer - 5 rows emitted. p3: 23 consecutive inked bands from the top rule, then empty to the footer - 23 rows emitted. Ink-scored, not band-scored; both agree with the eye count at 200 dpi.

gates.balance_chain: Cover line 4 (balance at end of period) is left EMPTY in all three columns, so the form prints no balance to chain. Computed for the record only, NOT written to the form: 4,996.91 + 25.00 - 5,021.91 = 0.00 exactly - the filing is internally consistent and self-liquidating. No earlier filing by this filer is in this chunk (line 1/2/3 LAST-REPORT cells are slashed zeros, i.e. the filer asserts this is his first report of the cycle), so the cross-filing TOTALS-FROM-LAST-REPORT chain has nothing to run against.

notes: DOCUMENT CONTRADICTS THE CHUNK FILE, LOUDLY: the chunk file / index.csv say office 'Assessor'; the county's own FILE NAME says 'Recorder'; and the cover's Office line is BLANK - the form names no office at all, so NEITHER label is document-confirmed. Kept in scope as a county-office filing because nothing in the document indicates otherwise, but the office itself is undetermined from the page. Two further cover misfills that could be mistaken for a school-board filing but are NOT: 'Representative District' is filled '75' (a Utah HOUSE district number, not a county or school-board district) and 'In the ____ School District' is filled 'Washington County' (the county name, not a Local School Board seat number). Contrast the module's genuine school-board exclusions, which name a numbered 'Local School Board' seat explicitly - none of that language appears here, so this is NOT treated as out-of-scope. Generation-2 county-branded form: Form A carries the 'In Kind? Y/N' column, Form B the four-column layout; both print a TOTAL footer. Clerk RECEIVED stamp JUN 08 2020; certification period 1-20-2020 to 4-18-2020; signed 4-25-2020. IN-KIND: rows 1-3 of Form A carry a hand-drawn DASH in the In Kind column and rows 4-5 are empty - a bare dash is not a 'Y' and not a 'N', so in_kind is false everywhere and the dash is noted per row rather than read as an answer. DATE OUTSIDE THE STATED PERIOD, retained verbatim: Form B row 18 is dated 4-20-2020, two days after the certified period end of 4-18-2020 - the filer's own inconsistency, not repaired. Form B rows 13-15 and 19-21 are out of chronological order (January/February entries listed after April ones) - transcribed in printed order. Privacy: the cover prints the candidate's home street address, ZIP and phone, and Form A's Mailing Address column carries full street addresses - all street/PO/ZIP/phone detail discarded at read time; only donor city and state are recorded here.
